reason: I want to make the carved design needed for printing; a chisel and planks seem suited to that.
expectation: I expect a carved wooden block or another press component, though its exact role is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might make ink, but the carved design seems like a useful first step.

effect: The carved plank became a printing block, which can now be combined with iron toward the press.
reaction: The result fits the expected role of the carved wood.
reason: Combining the printing block with iron seems likely to build the press.
expectation: I expect a printing press or a component of one, though the iron's exact role is unclear.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water may make ink, but building the press is the current goal.

effect: The block and iron made the press, revealing the goal of printing a page. The description says the block needs ink.
reaction: The explanation of the screw and plate makes the press feel concrete.
reason: Charcoal and water seem likely to make the ink needed for printing.
expectation: I expect ink or an ink ingredient, though I am not certain.

alternatives.reason: The press and paper relate directly to the goal, but the press description mentions an inked block.

effect: Charcoal and water made ink, which can now be added to the press.
reason: The press description says the block needs ink, so adding it should prepare the press for printing.
expectation: I expect an inked press ready to print on paper.

alternatives.reason: Paper is needed for the page, but I expect the press needs ink first.

effect: The press is inked and ready for paper, confirming the next step toward printing a page.
reaction: The explanation of ink coating the raised surface makes the process clear.
reason: Combining the inked press with paper is the only offered gameplay action and directly serves the goal.

effect: The inked press and paper produced printed pages, completing the chapter's final goal.
reaction: Seeing the same illustration reproduced on multiple sheets makes the press's purpose clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the press was the most worthwhile moment: its description explained how the screw and plate apply pressure to the carved block.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making ink was straightforward, but its result offered little detail on its own.

surprise.text: The press description clarified how the iron screw and plate work together to make copies.

arbitrary.text: Combining the printing block with iron initially felt somewhat unclear; the resulting description explained the iron's role.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see what the settlement builds next, though the offered combinations made this chapter fairly predictable.
